ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance updated 29-Oct-2021 due to the effect of completed divestitures and global supply chain-related impacts (guidance October 2021 | previous guidance August 2021): Revenue ~$17.9 billion | $18.1 billion - $18.5 billion (includes the effect of completed divestitures). Organic revenue growth up ~2.0% | up 3.0% - 5.0%. Adjusted EBIT margin ~18.75% | ~18.5%. Non-GAAP EPS $12.85 - $13.00 | $12.80 - $13.00. Adjusted free cash flow $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion | $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion (excludes cash income taxes paid or avoided related to taxable gains and losses resulting from sales of businesses). Share repurchases ~$3.6 billion | ~$3.4 billion (includes the use of net proceeds from completed divestitures).
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (all acquired intangibles), business divestiture-related gains/losses and other divestiture-related expenses, impairment of goodwill and other assets / investment and asset impairment charges, restructuring and other items, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs + (new this quarter) cash income taxes paid on taxable gains and losses from sales of businesses (239). PRESENTATION CHANGE: the release replaces the separate adjusted-EBIT and EPS reconciliation tables with one columnar table (As reported | Adjustments | Non-GAAP). Only the total per-share adjustment (0.82, incl. the NCI portion) is printed, so eps_bridge has a single line; the dollar adjustments by line are in item_amounts (total pre-tax 177 = 170 unallocated items + 7 non-operating income; income-tax effect (9); non-GAAP income from continuing operations 647 on 201.6 million diluted shares). adj_ebit_bridge starts from EBIT 653 rather than net income. Non-GAAP net interest (67) and non-GAAP income tax expense (116) are shown in the table.
